title: The _self rules answer how a public ledger entry cites a _self doc line and how a gap step's rules miss is recorded
goal: A tested _self question (a lookup_eval.csv row of the _self root) answers how a public-root ledger entry such as a _gaps.md resolution cites a line of a _self doc, which check.py refuses as a path:line, and how a gap the gap step filed on the wrong root is recorded as a rules finding, so rag.py pack --root _self --item gives a worker the rule; seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where ST-4czhz3ar's pack --item returned coverage none and the worker found both by reading the query-log doc and meeting the check.py error
